Name: Lil Yachty Collab Album*
Notes: Privately mentioned to have been a thing from Yachty's manager during 2018-2020, however, it was never mentioned to the public. Only two confirmed songs are known to exist between the two, one being "Asshole" on LB3.5 and an alledged feature on the unleaked track "Highschool Dreams" but with no vocals being leaked from Oliver. it is unknown if any more songs were recorded.

Name: Alone in a Crowd [Late 2022]
Notes: Mastered copy of Alone in a Crowd from late 2022, submitted for pressing prior to Oliver making changes to the release. This copy is used on some physical distributions of the album, and is now referred to officially as the "lost original mixes". Contains a few minor differences to the final version, most notably with Essence having a cut verse in the intro.

Name: Alone in a Crowd [Deluxe]
Notes: While the existence of an Alone in a Crowd Deluxe was never officially confirmed, it was expected by most of Oliver's fans to follow Alone in a Crowd as he had done with his previous projects, and one was heavily rumored to exist in early 2024 - however, for unknown reasons, the supposed deluxe never surfaced, with Oliver telling fans not to expect one. It is not known for certain if it was scrapped, or simply never existed.

Name: Tommy Cash Collab EP*
Notes: In an interview from late 2023, Oliver would confirm that him and Tommy Cash had planned on releasing a collab EP between both of them but both wanted to focus on their own music before releasing it. It's unknown if they are still planning on releasing it after LYM,HYB & Tommy Cash's next project.
